title: Ultimate Pathes
description: This mod adds new path types made from a variety of materials
body:
Need more paths? This mod adds new path types made from a variety of materials, from stone to magma! Plow blocks with a shovel, and get more options by plowing again.

The composition includes such blocks as:
grasspath- sand - stone - magma - mud - moss - ice - sandstone - cobblestone - endstone

Click on existing sand and gravel to create a suspicious texture.
